author: Nelev
body:
## What

- `POST /documents` in `main.py`: takes the multipart `file` field, signed-in only (`CurrentUser`), answers `{"status": "ok"}`. The file is accepted and dropped; nothing is stored or indexed yet.
- No new dependency: `fastapi[standard]` already ships `python-multipart`.
- README API table gains the row.

This is the endpoint the composer's upload button in #46 posts to.

## Not in this PR

- Storing the file, checking it is a PDF, size limits, indexing it into the RAG store.

## Testing

- `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .`, `uv run pytest -q` (143 passing, including two new: an upload returns 200 `{"status": "ok"}`, a signed-out upload is 401).
